title: SpecStatus
description: One hexagon's living-spec freshness row (D144; SPEC_TEMPLATE.md v2), served by `agent-runner`'s `/specs/*` routes and read by `dashboard`. `specVersion` is the spec's version as written (v2 `spec-version: 7` is "7"; a v1 spec keeps its own spelling), `null` when none. `contractAsOf`/`stateAsOf` are dates, `verifiedAgainst` the commit (and contracts version) the state zone was verified against, `commitsSince` the real commits since then; each is `null` when the spec has no such field (a v1 spec, `v2: false`). `driftCount` is the open drift items, `openQuestions` the open owner questions, `reviewWindowDays` the review window and `due` whether the spec is past it. `lastJob` is the latest spec-sync or spec-seed job, `null` when none ran.
